The '''Avesta family''' was a wealthy group of [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant explorers during the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]].

==History==
Remaining staunchly independent from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Makeb]] began to attract economic leaders, banking corporations, and wealthy tourists, leading to the rise in number of luxury resorts across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Avesta family established a number of profitable settlements in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of Makeb's colonization, and they eventually established the [[Avesta Mining Corporation]]. The Avesta family also helped establish the [[Makeb Business Council]], the planet's government. Members of the Avesta family negotiated a trade partnership with the Republic.
